headline: Airbus forecasts passenger traffic in Central Asia to nearly triple by 2045
summary: Airbus projects that air passenger traffic in Central Asia will rise nearly threefold by 2045. Growth is driven by an expanding middle class with annual household incomes above $20,000, with demand fastest on routes among the region's five countries.
why: Airbus is a major commercial aircraft manufacturer, so regional traffic forecasts shape its order outlook and that of airlines and airports.
